element.reason: DS-COMPLETE round 3 (D2): the shadcn BlockViewer iframe document reduced to one specimen on the page ground: the pinned theme swatches, the pinned font ramp and one component in its specimen state, which Producer specimen pages place and never style. Created through the Designer create path as a component-layer slot that installs into @clossys/designer-ui (src/components/specimen-document.tsx); the Foundry extension under src/foundry re-exports it only. DS-COMPLETE D5: source.ref cites reference-manifest row ids only. DS-COMPLETE D7: no English literal is left in the file; the theme title and sample, the swatch glyph, the font sample and the ramp labels are props the page fills from Writer keys (strings.common studio.specimen-sample.*).
